rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for doing something in a rude or impolite manner.

example.english: They rudely interrupted me while I was talking.
example.traditional: 佢哋冇禮貌咁打斷我講嘢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 mou5 lai5 maau6 gam2 daa2 dyun6 ngo5 gong2 je5

rows.note: Use this when the rude behavior is especially rough, blunt, or uncouth rather than merely lacking politeness.

example.english: They rudely yelled at someone so loudly that even the customers at the next table could hear.
example.traditional: 佢粗魯咁鬧人，連隔籬枱嘅客都聽到。
example.jyutping: keoi5 cou1 lou5 gam2 naau6 jan4 lin4 gaak3 lei4 toi4 ge3 haak3 dou1 teng1 dou2
